meaning:
A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at 1Ch.9.4;
son of: Ammihud (H5989K)
§ Uthai = "helpful"
1) son of Ammihud and a descendant of Pharez of Judah
2) one of the sons of Bigvai who returned from exile with the 2nd caravan with Ezra

elsewhere.note: Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the children of Perez the son of Judah.
Of the sons of Bigvai, Uthai and Zabbud; and with them seventy males.
